items.title: Powering the B-21 Raider - East Gate 3 Grand Opening
items.category: 軍用航空機・製造技術
items.excerpt: Northrop Grumman opened East Gate 3 in Layton, Utah, adding manufacturing capacity for B-21 Raider production. The East Gate campus is planned to total about 845,000 sq ft and support up to 1,500 employees by 2032; the company says the expansion supports production acceleration and scale-up.
items.query: Northrop Grumman September 2026 B-21 digital engineering manufacturing

items.title: BAE Systems launches Shadow EW compact electronic warfare solutions
items.category: 軍用航空機・航空電子
items.excerpt: BAE Systems launched the Shadow EW family for small airborne platforms. The company says the low-SWaP, software-defined products use commercial microchips, open architectures and field-upgradeable software; production is planned in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, with software and design work in Nashua, New Hampshire.
items.query: BAE Systems September 2026 aircraft manufacturing digital engineering aerospace

items.title: CoreWeave Launches Physical AI Field Engineering to Turn Proprietary Data Into Production AI
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: CoreWeave launched Physical AI Field Engineering, built on the Monolith AI team, to embed engineering-AI specialists with customers. Models use test, simulation, sensor and telemetry data and are validated against system physics; CoreWeave says the approach has been applied across 100+ engineering projects including aerospace.
items.query: CoreWeave Physical AI Field Engineering September 2026 engineering aerospace

items.title: Building Beyond CAD: On Generative Optimization for Engineering
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: PhysicsX describes adapting 3D foundation models to engineering geometry, then coupling generated shapes with numerical simulation and physics-AI reward models. In a SimJEB jet-engine-bracket example, PhysicsX reports an FEA-loop design 18.5% lighter than the prior winner while meeting the stress constraint, without CAD parameters.
items.query: PhysicsX Building Beyond CAD generative optimization engineering August 2026

items.title: Swiss company Neural Concept Establishes Direct Presence in India to Accelerate AI-Native Engineering Across Automotive and Manufacturing
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Neural Concept opened direct teams in Bengaluru and Pune to support deployment of its physics-aware Engineering Intelligence platform across design and simulation workflows. The company serves aerospace and defense engineering users as well as automotive and manufacturing, making it a strong candidate for recurring engineering-AI monitoring.
items.query: Neural Concept September 2026 engineering AI aerospace

items.title: SimScale Opens Simulation AI Agent to 900,000 Users
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: ENGtechnica reports that SimScale made a simulation AI agent available to its community, automating CAD geometry cleanup, simulation setup and validated output reporting. The release is directly aligned with agentic CAE workflows and is worth recurring watchlist coverage even though this item is from a secondary engineering-industry source.
items.query: SimScale simulation AI agent August 2026 CAD CAE
